body:
> You will see "Set main_scene" in the message output.
> Immediately close the Project Settings window. You will see another "Set main_scene" in the message output.

The first message is from pressing enter, the second from property text field loosing focus. But both seems to be setting the property to the same value (current context of the text field). Changing the setting starts (or resets) a 1.5 sec timer which saves settings to disk. I guess this is done to avoid saving it too frequently.

> Attempt to run the project. It will load into whichever scene was the main_scene prior to being changed.

If you manage to start the project before this timer ends, it will use the old setting.

Should be easy to fix by immediately saving settings when window is closed (already done for the editor settings). But I'm not sure if I'm reproducing exactly the same thing.
I thought I was crazy for having to change the main scene 4 times and always getting it reset to the prior one.

Changing the setting starts (or resets) a 1.5 sec timer which saves settings to disk. I guess this is done to avoid saving it too frequently.

> > Attempt to run the project. It will load into whichever scene was the main_scene prior to being changed.
> 
> If you manage to start the project before this timer ends, it will use the old setting.
> 
> Should be easy to fix by immediately saving settings when window is closed (already done for the editor settings). But I'm not sure if I'm reproducing exactly the same thing.

I tested this and yes, it's the same issue. If I intentionally WAIT after changing the setting and closing the project settings window before hitting the run button on my project it works properly. Plus, if I don't wait, run the project, and get the previous main_scene, but then close the game and immediately re-run, I now get the new main_scene.
